prompt:
State the physical quantity represented by:
(a) the gradient of an energy against time graph [1]
(b) the area under a power against time graph [1]

mark_scheme.criterion: (a) States power (or rate of energy transfer).

hints: For gradient, think of vertical unit divided by horizontal unit: J / s.
For area, think of vertical unit multiplied by horizontal unit: W * s.
solution:
(a) The gradient of an energy against time graph represents power.
(b) The area under a power against time graph represents work done (or energy transferred).
teacher_walkthrough: Part (a): Gradient = Delta E / Delta t = P (power).
Part (b): Area = P * Delta t = W (work done or energy transferred).
